definitions.falseInterventionRate: Annotated Normal/Struggling confirmed or cancelled sessions with >=1 displayed warning / all such sessions.
definitions.observedLeadMs: Actual confirmation time minus first displayed warning time; includes cool-down and user response delays.
definitions.unbiasedShadowLeadMs: Not measured by this live run. Requires a separate uninterrupted matched reference.
definitions.warningToReviewMs: First review-entry time minus first warning time, only when the warning precedes review.
